derivatives.name: tiger-mark
derivatives.prompt: Edit this approved Järna Kung Fu & Kultur logo into its text-free favicon master. Remove ALL lettering and the Ä diacritic dots; retain ONLY the exact approved tiger head, centered on a square canvas. Preserve its identity, facial anatomy, eyes, closed mouth, cheek contours, stripe shapes and ear shapes as faithfully as possible. Same exact saturated warm golden-yellow background and solid black print. Tiger head fills 82% of square, with equal safe breathing room on every side. Favor bold clean silhouettes and clear yellow gaps, gently reduce the tiny worn-ink speckles so it reads at 32 pixels, but preserve the Shaolin black-and-yellow print character. No text, no symbols, no frame, no mockup, no additional artwork. This is a faithful brand derivative, not a new tiger design.

derivatives.name: og-image
derivatives.prompt: Adapt the supplied approved logo into a finished landscape Open Graph social sharing image for Järna Kung Fu & Kultur. Intended format 1200x630 (1.905:1 aspect), landscape. Preserve the EXACT approved tiger head identity, saturated warm golden-yellow background, black ink and restrained distressed silkscreen print feel. Recompose for landscape: tiger head on the LEFT, text on RIGHT, with generous safe margins. Text reads EXACTLY on three left-aligned lines: 'JÄRNA' then 'KUNG FU' then '& KULTUR'. KUNG FU is the dominant largest lettering, JÄRNA visibly smaller (about half its cap height), & KULTUR substantial and easy to read. Match the supplied chunky condensed block letter style, rough print edges and correct Swedish Ä. The tiger and whole wordmark are optically balanced, plenty of separation, no overlap. Keep all critical elements inside central 85% of canvas, no edges cropped. Logo artwork only, no website mockup, no extra text or tagline, no URL, no new symbols, no gradients. Visually exactly the same approved identity, adapted to a wide social preview.
